_comment: Tool: get_advisory(ghsa_id) -> { ghsa_id, cve_id, severity, cvss, summary, vulnerable_functions[], source }. Fetches OSV.dev (no auth, public) for severity/cvss/summary, and the demo repo's own security/vulnerable_functions.json (raw.githubusercontent.com, no auth on a public repo) for function-level data -- see prompts/security_agent.md and stormbreakers-demo-shop/security/vulnerable_functions.json for why the fallback file exists. Import into n8n, then in the 'Fetch fallback config' node's URL, replace OWNER/REPO with your actual demo repo path once it exists. Test standalone with input {"ghsa_id": "GHSA-8q59-q68h-6hv4"} before wiring into the Security Agent.
name: AutoRelease Tool - get_advisory
